title: Completion-state store shape: spa-local-storage default (Q4 fallback), spa-session-storage or server-side-per-principal
context: The completion state needs a store. Three shapes are legal. spa-local-storage keeps the completion state per browser and per principal identifier; a returning principal on the same browser is not re-onboarded, and a different browser (or a private window) is re-onboarded. spa-session-storage keeps the completion state per session and re-plays the tour on every new session; useful only for a project that deliberately wants a per-session refresher. server-side-per-principal keeps the completion state on the principals record so it follows the user across devices; requires an applied persistence blueprint and the projects own writer adapter. The spec section 5.5 and section 10 Q4 ratify spa-local-storage as the fallback when no persistence blueprint is applied because a per-session tour that re-plays on every new session is worse than a one-time tour that persists across sessions on that browser.
decision: completion-state-store is elicited (enum: spa-local-storage | spa-session-storage | server-side-per-principal). Recommended default: spa-local-storage. At apply time the elicit surface offers all three; a project that answers server-side-per-principal without an applied persistence blueprint hits a documented refusal (the elicit's when predicate refuses per the mechanism this minor version does not extend; the refusal is enforced at the surface load by TAC-2703 which refuses to construct a server-side backend without a resolved persistence adapter and falls back to spa-local-storage with a documented note on the sidecar).
consequences: A project with no persistence blueprint applied gets the spa-local-storage backend automatically per the Q4 fallback; a project with a persistence blueprint and the server-side-per-principal answer gets a cross-device tour completion; a project answering spa-session-storage accepts a per-session re-onboarding. The dismiss-until-next-major and dismiss-until-next-minor policies (ADR-2701) still work under any of the three shapes because the CompletionRecord.blueprintSetVersion travels with the record.

alternativesConsidered.name: Alternative approach considered
alternativesConsidered.summary: spa-session-storage as the default was considered but re-onboarding on every new session is intrusive on a stable product; the Q4 ratification names spa-local-storage as the fallback for that reason.
alternativesConsidered.reasonNotChosen: See the decision text; the chosen default composes cleanly with the applied blueprint set the spec section 5.5 names.
